hook: A fair, truthful trading mechanism always captures at least half the possible gains from trade.
hook_turn: at least half the possible gains from trade.
summary: The paper proves a mechanism with incentive compatibility and budget balance captures at least half of first-best gains in multidimensional two-sided markets. The proof uses duality and Markov chains stopped by exponential clocks. The half guarantee is tight already for one item, and it assumes additive values and independent agent types.
title: Second-Best Trade Is Half Efficient in Multidimensional Markets
